headline: 12 killed, including 2 Bangladeshis, in Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport
summary: The attack targeted King Khalid International Airport in Saudi Arabia, causing explosions and fires in the passenger terminal.
details: A missile attack by Houthi rebels targeted the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
The attack resulted in the death of 12 people, including two Bangladeshi citizens.
Reports indicate that explosions were heard at the airport, followed by fires breaking out in the passenger terminal area.
Saudi authorities are managing the situation as the impact of the Houthi missile strike is assessed.
caption:

headline: Govt to build international airport in Trishal, Mymensingh
summary: A feasibility study will be conducted soon to establish a full-fledged international airport in the area to support future development.
details: Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat announced that the government will take steps to build a full-fledged international airport in Trishal, Mymensingh, near Dhaka.

A feasibility study will be conducted soon to determine the viability of the {// a feasibility study will be conducted soon to determine the viability of the} project, which was previously identified as a preferred location in a 2010 pre-feasibility study.
The announcement was made during a reception for GPA-5 students in Mymensingh, organized by the Mymensingh City Corporation.
Beyond the airport, the minister also revealed plans for Biman Bangladesh Airlines to purchase 35 new aircraft, including 25 Boeing and 10 Airbus planes.
These aircraft are scheduled for delivery in phases between 2031 and 2036-37, with the minister requesting Airbus to deliver at least one aircraft by 2026-27.

caption:
A new international airport is coming to Mymensingh! ✈️

Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat announced that the government will take steps to build a full-fledged international airport in Trishal, Mymensingh, near Dhaka.

A feasibility study will be conducted soon to determine the viability of the {// a feasibility study will be conducted soon to determine the viability of the} project, which was previously identified as a preferred location in a 2010 pre-feasibility study.

The announcement was made during a reception for GPA-5 students in Mymensingh, organized by the Mymensingh City Corporation.

Beyond the airport, the minister also revealed plans for Biman Bangladesh Airlines to purchase 35 new aircraft, including 25 Boeing and 10 Airbus planes.

These aircraft are scheduled for delivery in phases between 2031 and 2036-37, with the minister requesting Airbus to deliver at least one aircraft by 2026-27.

The government also aims to expand direct international air connectivity to destinations such as New York, Sydney, South Korea, and China.

Additionally, the minister mentioned plans to develop Birishiri in Netrokona as a tourism destination and upgrade Mymensingh Engineering College into a full-fledged university.

State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Yaser Khan Chowdhury also announced the construction of an information complex in the district, with similar complexes planned for all 64 districts.
